newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Grain Exchange volume hits record in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Grain Exchange volume hits record in 1996.

text.p: Trading volume on the Tokyo Grain Exchange (TGE) hit a record high of 27.51 million lots in calendar 1996, up 87.8 percent from the prior year, reflecting heavy trade in grain futures, an exchange official said on Friday.
The official said the volatility of grain prices on the Chicago Board of Trade this year helped spur active speculative interest in the Tokyo market as well.
The volume of corn futures traded on the TGE reached a record high of 16.03 million lots in 1996, more than double the 6.89 million lots traded in 1995.
Turnover of U.S. soybean futures also hit a record of 7.12 million lots in 1996, up sharply from 2.70 million lots last year.
